title: Validate noisy recordings and DE10-Lite hardware bring-up
description: Run clean, stationary-noise, impulsive-noise, clipping and real-environment recordings; compare FPGA/reference; measure detection stability; compile, program and verify DE10-Lite GPIO/I2S and feature packets.
acceptance_criteria: Automated regression, noisy pass metrics, reproducible Quartus timing/fit and documented board bring-up are complete.

title: Optimize DE10-Lite throughput, RAM/DSP use and timing

acceptance_criteria: Quartus fit completes; timing closes; utilization report is checked in; analyzer latency is below hop interval; overflow/frame-drop counters exist.

title: Add FPGA noise-robustness processing and feature stabilization
description: Add selectable noise-floor estimation, spectral/noise flooring or subtraction, per-band normalization, VAD/energy gating, temporal EMA smoothing and robust clipping handling for stationary and non-stationary noise.
acceptance_criteria: Noisy fixtures show lower stationary-noise MFCC variance while preserving active-signal detection; bypass and parameters are documented; no frame overruns.

title: Implement orthonormal DCT-II MFCC pipeline
description: Correct DCT normalization to match scipy/librosa orthonormal DCT-II and support 13/20 MFCC outputs with fixed-point error bounds, optional liftering and coefficient selection.
acceptance_criteria: DCT outputs match reference for 32/40/64 log-Mel vectors; MFCC0 scale, rounding and saturation are verified.

title: Generate and integrate normalized Mel and log coefficient ROMs
description: Replace hand-coded Mel edges/weights and coarse logarithm with reproducibly generated ROM coefficients matching the selected reference. Support fmin/fmax, Slaney or HTK scale, band normalization, Nyquist handling and configurable log floor. Cover 32/40/64 bands.
acceptance_criteria: Generated ROMs are reproducible and FPGA Mel/log values match Python vectors; silence and near-silence remain finite.

title: Correct FFT block-floating scaling and power spectrum precision
description: Use bfpexp and FFT scaling metadata to reconstruct a common physical scale. Replace approximate magnitude for MFCC with real^2+imag^2 or documented equivalent, widen accumulators, add saturation and overflow diagnostics, and keep wider internal values than any debug transport.
acceptance_criteria: Equal-amplitude frames have stable scale across bfpexp values; full-scale complex-bin vectors do not overflow; FPGA results match reference within tolerance.

title: Implement exact audio clocking, windowing and overlapped framing
description: Replace approximate I2S timing with calibrated 48 kHz clocking or fractional division, add selectable pre-emphasis, apply Hann/Hamming window, and implement deterministic 50-percent-overlap framing for 512/1024-point analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Measured sample rate meets tolerance; window ROM and hop scheduling are verified; no frame-boundary sample loss; 512 and 1024 configurations elaborate.
notes: Implementados clock I2S fracionário por NCO (50 MHz -> média 3,072 MHz em 48 kHz/64 bits), ROM Hann Q1.15 em M9K e multiplicador antes da FFT. Pipeline mantém modo legado sem janela. Testes: tb_i2s_master_clock_gen, tb_audio_clock_fractional, tb_fft_window_multiplier, tb_aces_audio_to_fft_pipeline com instância windowed integrada. Sobreposição de 50% e controle de frames ainda pendentes.
